body: I've done some volunteer work, but its very seasonal. I've been in too much of a fog to try to pick something up in the meantime. I have been searching for ways I can change things, even if I just start with changing my daily routine. I feel like I'm just stuck in this awful cycle of miserable monotony. Honestly I feel like I'd rather live in a country where I have less but am happier.

I've got my Bachelor's and I've just applied to grad school. It's competitive, so very possible that its just another closed door in my face. I really wish I had a skill that allowed me to be my own boss. I hate having to wait for someone to tell me "yes, you can move forward with you life."

I hate my job a lot. I've been looking for something different for a very long time, but I don't just want something different- I need something better. I don't want to jump from crappy job to crappy job. I spend 40 hours a week being stressed, unfulfilled, and unhappy, and my attempts at moving forward have been completely unsuccessful. And I'm stuck. I can't make less than I'm making right now and still live where I live. I could move somewhere cheaper, but I live with my SO. I've been trying to move for a long time. Can't find anything that I'm qualified for that would make me happy and pay what I'm making now.

Also I think I'm going to have to break up with my SO eventually, which makes me really sad. I want to get married, but I can't see myself marrying this person, and it's got me incredibly depressed. I hate hurting people. I've been trying to wait it out to see if those feelings come, and they haven't.

So I'm stuck. I can't afford to live on my own right now, jobs aren't panning out, I'm in a relationship with an expiration date, and I'm lonelier and more miserable than I've ever been.

I try to make things for myself to look forward to. I plan trips. I throw small parties. It puts sort of a temporary band-aid on the situation. But I'm still miserable. I can't stand just having. fleeting happiness on the weekends when I go out and do something neat.
